name: Furimuite Cool Eye's
source:
School manga research club is in pinch! It only has three members and will have to disband unless two more members are found within a month. Main character should also recruit only among the girls in order not to repeat last year's mistake when a lot of people had to quit the club due to romantic problems. Is it possible to save the club?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
学校漫画研究部陷入危机！社团只有三名成员，若不能在一个月内再招到两人，就会被迫解散。为了避免重演去年许多人因恋爱纠纷退出社团的错误，主人公这次还必须只从女孩中招募成员。他能够拯救社团吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
